evals.name: Profile CPU bottleneck with cProfile
evals.description: Given a slow Python script, use cProfile to identify the top time-consuming functions
evals.input: Python script with multiple functions, one of which is a clear CPU bottleneck
evals.expected: cProfile output identifying the bottleneck function with cumulative time stats
criteria: cProfile is used correctly with enable/disable or context manager
Results are sorted by cumulative time
The bottleneck function is identified and reported

evals.name: Optimize memory with generators and __slots__
evals.description: Given a memory-intensive class and data processing code, reduce memory footprint
evals.input: Class with many instances and a function that loads large datasets into lists
evals.expected: Class uses __slots__, data processing uses generators instead of lists
criteria: __slots__ is added to the class definition
List comprehensions replaced with generators where full materialization is not needed

evals.name: Add caching to expensive recursive function
evals.description: Given a recursive function with overlapping subproblems, add lru_cache for performance
evals.input: Recursive function (e.g., fibonacci, tree traversal) called repeatedly with same inputs
evals.expected: Function decorated with @lru_cache, with measurable speedup demonstrated
criteria: lru_cache is applied correctly with appropriate maxsize
Cache info is accessible for monitoring
Performance improvement is demonstrated with timing comparison
